source.title: Liebherr Mobile Crane LTM 1500-8.1 Technische Daten / Technical Data (50 m telescopic boom version), official Liebherr datasheet hosted by FreeCraneSpecs.com

notes: Official Liebherr metric datasheet, hosted by a third party (freecranespecs.com), not downloaded from liebherr.com; edition date not printed. Uses the 360° table: 135 t counterweight is the heaviest 360° telescopic-boom table in this document. The 165 t full counterweight (135 t + 2 x 15 t extra slabs) only applies to the over-rear 16.1 m columns on this page and to the guyed TY3 tables, so those were left out. The two over-rear 16.1 m columns (footnotes 1 and 2) are excluded. The table icon shows no outrigger base; 10.0 x 9.6 m is the full base from the p.94 dimension drawing (10012 x 9600 mm; the partial transverse base is 6250 mm), and Mammoet's datasheet also lists 10x9.6 m for the main table. operatingWeight_t = 96 t is the road weight (8 x 12 t) with the 50 m boom. Max hook height is not stated numerically for the T boom. Max outrigger force is not stated in this document. Liebherr charts treat hook block/hook weight as part of the load, so it must be deducted (heaviest hook block 274.1 t / 13 sheaves = 6.1 t, p.95). The cell at 47.3 m / 46 m radius is 18 t, lower than 18.2 t at 50 m, exactly as printed. Discrepancy: Mammoet's 2015 datasheet (mammoet.com, SAP 4000101733) lists 274 t instead of 500/400/325 t at 3–4 m for 16.1 m, likely due to a hook-block limit or a different chart edition. An 84 m boom version of the LTM 1500-8.1 also exists and is not covered here. | 2026-09-24: 16.1 m boom at 3.0/3.5/4.0 m (500/400/325 t as printed) set to null — Mammoet datasheet lists 274 t there; treated as special-equipment ratings (conservative).
